items.quote: Wenn Sie verhindert sind, sagen Sie bitte mindestens zwei Werktage vorher ab, damit wir den Termin anderweitig vergeben können.
items.computation: Appointment is Monday, 14.12.2026. Counting backward, Werktage (working days) are usually Monday–Saturday in German usage (Sundays and public holidays excluded). The day before the appointment, Sunday 13.12.2026, is not a Werktag. The first Werktag before the appointment is therefore Saturday 12.12.2026 (1st Werktag), and the second Werktag before is Friday 11.12.2026 (2nd Werktag). 'Mindestens zwei Werktage vorher' therefore means the cancellation must reach the practice by Friday, 11.12.2026 at the latest. (If the practice instead counts Werktage as Mon–Fri only, excluding Saturday, the deadline would shift one day earlier to Thursday 10.12.2026 — this ambiguity is noted as the practice itself does not define the term.)

warnings: The practice's definition of 'Werktage' (working days) is not stated; if it excludes Saturdays, the cancellation deadline would be Thursday 10.12.2026 instead of Friday 11.12.2026 — confirm with the practice if timing is tight.
No consequence (e.g. a cancellation fee) is stated in the letter for missing the two-working-day notice period, so none is assumed.
